title: Lord of the Flies with Senpai
overview: Kondo needs help coming up with a subject to write on for the national school newspaper contest. Will the girls be able to help her write a contest winning article?

title: Se7en with Senpai
overview: The girls are exhausted after another hard day of everything but practicing tennis. They decide to get ramen to fill their empty stomachs.

title: 28 Days Later with Senpai
overview: The girls are going to the beach... if they can even make it there. With so many problems plaguing their trip there, will there ever be a beach episode?

title: Titanic with Senpai
overview: The girls are enjoying themselves at the beach when calamity strikes. Is this the end of the Kameido tennis club?

title: The Super-Scary Super-Strange Files! Scariest Movie Ever with Senpai
overview: After a day at the beach, the girls head to an inn to spend the night. However, there is a foreboding air about the shadow looking in...

title: Night at the Museum with Senpai
overview: The girls are bored at school when Nasuno announces that she bought an art museum. They immediately head there to check out the art, but the objects on display aren't what they were expecting.

title: Oblivion with Senpai
overview: The girls decide to have some fun playing an online RPG. Will their party amass a wealth of equipment and experience points or end in tragedy?

title: Face/Off with Senpai
overview: Yuri wakes up one morning to discover she's inside Marimo's body. But when she gets to school, she finds another version of herself inside her own body. Who is who? Who is the real Yuri?

title: Once Upon a Time in America with Senpai
overview: It's Kanae's first year of high school. Discover the exciting adventure that led her and Nasuno to join the tennis club.

title: Once Upon a Time in China with Senpai
overview: The upperclassmen's flashback continues. With Kanae and Nasuno already on the team, next to join them is...

title: Enemy of the State with Senpai
overview: It's the day of the Kameido High Marathon and the tennis club is raring to go. When Kanae and Marimo show up with strangely muscular bodies, it's only the beginning of a typically atypical race.

title: Saturday Night Fever with Senpai
overview: The girls discover their tennis net is ripped, but all the club's funds have been spent on sandbags. With no other choice, they decide to work for a day at a fried chicken restaurant, where they run into a shockingly unfamiliar face.
